physical_source.target_juan: 卷三十四 志第十四 歷三
physical_source.edition: 明嘉靖十七年（1538）聞人詮吳郡刊本
physical_source.public_surrogate: Wikimedia Commons / National Central Library scan
physical_source.chronology_control: The surviving reviewed carrier is a catalogued Jiajing-17/1538 print. The much earlier work/composition history of Jiutangshu is kept separate and is not used to backdate this physical witness.

page_17.normalized_mechanical_reading: For the specified remainder calculation, use 100 as denominator; a half or more advances one, below half is discarded; the following guilou calculation says a non-full remainder follows the same rule.
page_17.local_context_control: The same physical page proceeds into 推二十四氣定日, fixing the target inside the calendrical procedure rather than an unrelated marginal table.

locator_correction.reason: Direct boundary review superseded the exploratory move to fascicle 05. The 05→06 boundary continues the preceding lunar/phase procedure; the target wording is physically present on 06 p17.

mechanical_replay.rule_model: half-up at 0.5 on a base-100 remainder: Q(x)=floor(x)+1 when fractional_part(x)>=0.5, otherwise floor(x)
mechanical_replay.conclusion: The Jiutangshu rule is a genuine pre-1578 historical fractional-to-integer reduction mechanism and directly mentions guilou, but it cannot be promoted to one universal reduction rule for the C-II-N interior ladder plus Nanjing 59 endpoint. It remains a source-scoped component candidate, especially for endpoint-style reduction classes.

transmission_impact.lineage_scope: Secure 1538 physical attestation of a base-100 half-up/discard-below-half rule explicitly extended to guilou. Structural synthesis component only; no direct Sanming ancestry or universal C-II-N mapping.

next_gate: Search pre-1578 Chinese Nanjing/Datong, Tongshu/almanac, clepsydra/change-arrow, or official-calendar sources for a state-dependent binding that preserves the C-II-N interior threshold sequence while producing the official Nanjing 59-ke endpoint.
Prioritize a source that also reproduces the Sanming/Yueling 大寒十三後 / 雨水後四日 fingerprint rather than only a generic rounding rule.
Treat the Jiutangshu half-up rule as a historically real mechanism class, not as proof that the 1578 Sanming table used it globally.
